More in one small window

Images, GIFs, audio, video, PDF, syntax highlighting, Markdown, CSV and ZIP / 7Z / RAR / TAR archive listings.

Office uses an independent engine to create static previews with pages, images, tables, charts and styles. Turn Word/PPT pages and switch Excel sheets. Text extraction remains a manual option. See the guide for limitations involving fonts, animation and complex objects.

Broader compatibility

Built-in FFmpeg handles missing system codecs. Every readable file offers basic properties, text detection or hex content.

Your files stay here

Local processing with no file uploads. Press Esc or Space to dismiss and continue working.

Built with Python, Qt for Python, Pygments, Python-Markdown and other open-source components. Licenses and source are included.
